description: Angular component for managing a row of JavaScript function modules, including form validation, description and source code loading, and event handling.

classes.name: JsFuncModuleRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for a module row with form controls, validation, and description/source code loading.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on form controls and returns validation errors.

methods.name: loadModuleDescription
methods.description: Loads module description as an observable string.

methods.name: loadModuleSourceCode
methods.description: Loads module source code as an observable string.

methods.name: moduleAliasValidator
methods.description: Validator function to ensure module alias is unique and valid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.
